text.aria-label: Title text 'Removing the look-ahead raises K2-S1's CRPS from 24 h onwards. Left of each pair: heads trained on look-ahead weather. Right: heads trained on origin-time weather. Dot: difference. Bar: Bonferroni interval, 5 month blocks (near min to max).'
text.tspan: Removing the look-ahead raises K2-S1's CRPS from 24 h onwards.
Left of each pair: heads trained on look-ahead weather.
Right: heads trained on origin-time weather.
Dot: difference. Bar: Bonferroni interval, 5 month blocks (near min to max).
